Container.Name: printlog-bridge
Container.Overview: Logs every print from your 3D printers to 3D Print Log (3dprintlog.com) automatically: Klipper printers through Moonraker, Bambu Lab printers in LAN mode, and Prusa printers through PrusaLink. Install it, open its log and scan the QR code with your phone to pair it with your 3D Print Log account. Then add your printers to printlog-bridge.cfg in the data folder: the bridge writes a starter file with an example for each kind of printer, and starts watching as soon as you save it, with no restart. Run printlog-bridge discover in the container's console to list the printers on your network. Host networking (the default) lets it find Bambu Lab printers and printers whose address changed; it opens no ports.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: 3d printing printer klipper moonraker bambu prusa prusalink print log
Container.Requires: A 3D Print Log account (https://www.3dprintlog.com), and printers on the same network: Klipper with Moonraker, Bambu Lab in LAN Only Mode with Developer Mode on, or Prusa with PrusaLink.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: The config (printlog-bridge.cfg: add your printers there) and state/ (the device token, the outbox, the log and the support bundle). The container gives it to the user set below.

Config.Name: Bridge name
Config.Description: Optional. The name 3D Print Log shows for this bridge once paired. Empty: printlog-bridge on your server's name.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user the bridge runs as, and owner of the data folder: 99 is nobody, the owner of Unraid's appdata.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional, instead of pairing: a key from https://www.3dprintlog.com/api-keys. A paired bridge ignores it. Anyone who can edit this container can read it.
